title: 保持依赖判定：投影闭包覆盖法
expected_output:
=== 保持依赖判定 ===
[用例 1] R(A,B,C)  F={A->B, B->C}  rho={R1(AB), R2(BC)}
  A->B     保持=YES
  B->C     保持=YES
  整体保持依赖 = YES

[用例 2] R(A,B,C)  F={A->B, B->C, C->A}  rho={R1(AB), R2(BC)}
  A->B     保持=YES
  B->C     保持=YES
  C->A     保持=NO  缺失:A
  整体保持依赖 = NO

[用例 3] 学生表 R(Sno,Sname,Dept,Dean) F={Sno->Sname, Sno->Dept, Dept->Dean}
        rho={R1(Sno,Sname), R2(Sno,Dept,Dean)}
  Sno->Sname     保持=YES
  Sno->Dept      保持=YES
  Dept->Dean     保持=YES
  整体保持依赖 = YES

对照: 用例 2 是无损连接(交集BC->A)但不保持依赖; 说明两个性质相互独立
code:
# 保持依赖(依赖保持)判定: 逐条 FD 检查是否被某个分片的投影蕴含
def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s)) or "-"


def preserved(fds, decomp):
    """对每条 FD X->Y: 逐属性检查 Y 中每个属性 A 是否属于
    ∪_i ( (X∩Ri)+ ∩ Ri )。"""
    detail = []
    ok_all = True
    for lhs, rhs in fds:
        recovered = set()
        for Ri in decomp:
            xr = set(lhs) & set(Ri)
            if not xr:
                continue
            cl = closure(frozenset(xr), fds)
            recovered |= (cl & set(Ri))
        miss = set(rhs) - recovered
        ok = not miss
        ok_all &= ok
        detail.append(("%s->%s" % (fmt(lhs), fmt(rhs)), ok, fmt(miss)))
    return ok_all, detail


print("=== 保持依赖判定 ===")

print("[用例 1] R(A,B,C)  F={A->B, B->C}  rho={R1(AB), R2(BC)}")
fds1 = [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")), (frozenset("B"), frozenset("C"))]
ok, det = preserved(fds1, [{"A", "B"}, {"B", "C"}])
for f, o, m in det:
    print("  %-8s 保持=%s%s" % (f, "YES" if o else "NO", "" if o else "  缺失:" + m))
print("  整体保持依赖 = " + ("YES" if ok else "NO"))
print()

print("[用例 2] R(A,B,C)  F={A->B, B->C, C->A}  rho={R1(AB), R2(BC)}")
fds2 = [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")), (frozenset("B"), frozenset("C")),
        (frozenset("C"), frozenset("A"))]
ok2, det2 = preserved(fds2, [{"A", "B"}, {"B", "C"}])
for f, o, m in det2:
    print("  %-8s 保持=%s%s" % (f, "YES" if o else "NO", "" if o else "  缺失:" + m))
print("  整体保持依赖 = " + ("YES" if ok2 else "NO"))
print()

print("[用例 3] 学生表 R(Sno,Sname,Dept,Dean) F={Sno->Sname, Sno->Dept, Dept->Dean}")
print("        rho={R1(Sno,Sname), R2(Sno,Dept,Dean)}")
fds3 = [(frozenset(["Sno"]), frozenset(["Sname"])),
        (frozenset(["Sno"]), frozenset(["Dept"])),
        (frozenset(["Dept"]), frozenset(["Dean"]))]
ok3, det3 = preserved(fds3, [{"Sno", "Sname"}, {"Sno", "Dept", "Dean"}])
for f, o, m in det3:
    print("  %-14s 保持=%s" % (f, "YES" if o else "NO"))
print("  整体保持依赖 = " + ("YES" if ok3 else "NO"))
print()
print("对照: 用例 2 是无损连接(交集BC->A)但不保持依赖; 说明两个性质相互独立")
